products.name: Dermisque 3X Vitamin C Face Serum
products.description: A brightening powerhouse that combines three forms of Vitamin C with Hyaluronic Acid and antioxidants. It helps even out skin tone, fade dark spots over time, defend against sun damage, and support your skin barrier and natural collagen for clearer, brighter, smoother skin.

ingredients.name: Silanol-infused Ascorbic Acid
ingredients.detail: Ascorbyl methylsilanol pectinate — a Vitamin C form designed for better penetration.

ingredients.name: Superox-C AF
ingredients.detail: Kakadu plum extract, rich in natural Vitamin C, for hydration and fewer fine lines.

ingredients.name: 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid
ingredients.detail: A stable Vitamin C derivative that helps even skin tone.

ingredients.name: Epidermosil
ingredients.detail: Silanetriol and Hyaluronic Acid for hydration and smoothness.

ingredients.name: Licorice, Vitamin E, D-Panthenol & Allantoin
ingredients.detail: Soothing, antioxidant support.

how_to_use: Cleanse your face and pat dry.
Dispense 2–3 drops (a pea-sized amount) onto your fingertips.
Dot over the face and neck, avoiding the eye area, then gently pat in until absorbed.
Follow with moisturiser. In the morning, always finish with broad-spectrum sunscreen.
Use consistently, once or twice daily, for best results.

faqs.a: It helps reduce dark spots, even out skin tone and boost radiance.

faqs.q: Can it help with fine lines?
faqs.a: Yes — the Superox-C component helps diminish the appearance of fine lines.

faqs.q: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
faqs.a: Our formulas are made for all skin types. If you have sensitive skin, patch-test on your inner arm 24 hours before first use and consult a dermatologist if irritation occurs.
Most people notice a visible difference in 3–4 weeks of consistent use. Skin renewal takes time — stay consistent.
Yes. Dermisque products are not tested on animals and are manufactured in ISO 9001:2015 and GMP certified facilities.
